name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You're back. If you're here for her, then you've wasted your trip. She hasn't been here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, figured. But we're here to ask about something else."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "We kiiinda picked up something weird. Figured you'd know about it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, looks like you do. So, d'you know what this is or something?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's said to be a tool used to carry out a certain ritual."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If you're interested... there are five... no, four out there."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Gather them all, and come back here."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'll teach you how to use the OOPArts, and about the ritual itself."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, I don't really care that much..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, someone's got stars in their eyes."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What about Shiorin, though...? But eh, if you wanna do it, it's fine, I guess..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I'll wait here, though I won't get my hopes up. These aren't things you can easily find."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "But if you really were chosen by the will of the firmament, you might find them without much trouble."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Now go. There's nothing more for you here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "OOPArts, huh... Sounds kinda sketchy, but hey, if you wanna collect them, then go ahead."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You're getting, like, way too hyped about this... What are these, even?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I found this here, in the parking lot."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now... would you lend me the four you found?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Thank you. Now that the five OOPArts have been brought together..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Uh, what're you clamming up for? You're losing me here. Go on, we're waiting."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "This is said to be a tool used for a certain ritual."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "What exactly is this higher being, or whether it truly appears at all, I don't know. I couldn't find any definitive information."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "However... *these* do exist. Objects that exude an aura unlike any ghost or aberration... anomalous presences known as OOPArts."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You found four, and I only one. The right to possess this... belongs to you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If you intend to perform the ritual, I'll teach you how."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Otherwise, I'd like you to hand it over. I'll add it to my collection."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "That's it? You're not gonna do it yourself?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I am bound to this place, and the ritual cannot be done here."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "So what will you do? Perform the ritual, or hand the OOPArts over to me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? What're you looking at me for? You decide, 'cause I don't care either way."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Ehehehe... So the day has come when all five are gathered. I'd already given up on that ever happening..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's a shame I can't verify its authenticity, but I suppose leaving a mystery as a mystery isn't so bad."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I thank you for handing over the OOPArts. I'll keep an eye out for your ghost."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now go. This is no place to linger for long."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She seemed really happy about it. Is it just me, or did we give up something really valuable?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Well... we still gotta find Shiorin, so whatever."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I kinda wanna ask what we're doing about Shiorin, but eh, whatever."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So? How do we do this ritual?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Go somewhere with a clear view of the sky, a place as wide and open as possible. The time doesn't matter."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Place the OOPArt on the ground, spread your arms toward the sky, and recite the incantation."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Did you memorize all that? 'Cause I didn't."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...How many times do I have to say it? You remember it already, don't you?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You're totally the type who keeps picking the wrong answer on purpose in video games, aren't you?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Just know that even I don't know what will happen. You have been warned. Be very careful."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And one more thing. I'd like you to report back once you've finished the ritual. Any time is fine."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...That is all, truly this time. Now go, the darkness is already upon you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "A ritual, huh... Sounds sketchy as hell, if you ask me, but..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, if you wanna do it, why not? What was it for again? To make something show up? Kinda got me curious."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What was it again, a wide place where you can see the sky? The park might work. Y'know, the one near our usual convenience store."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But eh, it's up to you if we'll do it or not."
